prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1035; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was driving through the intersection in Katy, Texas, on a green light when a vehicle coming from the cross street pulled out and struck the side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt a sharp pain in my right knee as it hit the dashboard area. I stayed at the scene until the police arrived and gave the same description of what happened to the officer, to the other driver's insurer, and to the adjuster who called me later. I have not changed any part of my account. I am the household member of the policyholder and live at the same address, and I was driving the insured vehicle with the policyholder's permission. I am asking the insurer to cover the medical treatment for my knee and the repairs to the car.
